item.title: Great porch! Circa 1901 in North Carolina. $170,000
item.description: Under an hour to the Outer Banks! That’s a big porch! The house looks like it spans a half a block. The house was built in 1901. It is located on .3 acre in Creswell, North Carolina. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, nice staircase, french doors, baseboards, picture rails, vintage light fixtures, crown moulding, brick fireplace and a large built-in corner cabinet. There is an attached two car garage. The interior could use some color, but it is like a blank slate.

item.title: Pretty area! The Neff Family House, Circa 1895 in Virginia. $279,000
item.description: This is a really pretty area! We drive through there on our way from Danville to Saltville. Love the vintage light fixtures. This house was built for the Neff Family. It was built in 1895. It is located on .45 acre in Rural Retreat, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, balcony, wood floors, nice staircase, stained glass, vintage light fixtures, baseboards, built-in corner cabinets, baseboards, wainscoting and pretty mantels. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,296 square feet. $27

item.title: Pretty setting and pretty trees! Over one acre in Oregon. $325,000
item.description: This house has a really pretty setting! I love all of the old trees on the property! The house was built in 1938. It is located on1 .39 acres in Waldport, Oregon. The house features knotty pine, nice windows for taking in the view, wood floors, crown moulding, arched entryways, brick fireplace and bead board. There is a detached storage building. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,452 square feet. $325,000 Contact Audra Powell with Premiere Property Group From the Zillow listing: Charming vintag

item.title: Has a guest apartment! 9 beds/4 baths. One acre in Pennsylvania. $220,000
item.description: This is a big house with nine bedrooms and four bathrooms. There is also a detached guest apartment. The house was built in 1920. It is located on one acre in Salisbury, Pennsylvania. The house features a covered front porch, porte cochere, great sunroom, wood floors, tall ceilings, crown moulding, stained glass windows, french doors, vintage light fixtures and unpainted woodwork. item.description: This is a pretty house! I love all of those porches! The price seems reasonable! The house was built in 1940. It is located on .68 acre in Marion, South Carolina. The house features a large covered front porch, pretty front door, wood floors, baseboards, huge bathroom, chair rails, picture rails, crown moulding, built-in bookshelves, arched entryways, claw foot tub, great back porch and a large screened in porch. item.title: Large sunroom! Almost two acres in Tennessee. Circa 1910. $229,000
item.description: That is a big sunroom! This would be a fun yard to landscape! The house was built in 1910. It is located on 1.7 acres in Millington, Tennessee. There house features a large sunroom, some wood floors, nice staircase, baseboards, crown moulding and built-in bookshelves. The house could use some character added back in, but it is livable and one could easily work room by room. I like the potential of the yard. item.title: Interesting Greek Revival Raised Cottage in Texas! Love the brick flooring! $624,900
item.description: This is an interesting Greek Revival raised cottage! I love the brick flooring on the bottom floor! They have a build date of 1870, but it is 1854. In 1870 they probably added on the iron work and the gothic revival gable to the front facade. It is located on .33 acre in Jefferson, Texas. item.title: Eclectic! Love the bathroom. Circa 1929 in Texas. $395,000
item.description: This house looks a bit eclectic. I like the bathroom and the backyard. The house was built in 1929. It is located in El Paso, Texas. The house features wood floors, baseboards, nice fireplaces, crown moulding and a claw foot tub. The home has a basement and a large back deck. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,829 square feet. $395,000 Contact Brenda Rogers with Dream Work Realty: 915-494-6004 From the Zillow listing: Charming and architecturally distinctive home just one block from Madeline Park

item.title: Louisiana’s most expensive old house listing! Circa 1860. Two acres. $4,950,000
item.description: Welcome to Louisiana’s most expensive old house listing! That old cistern turned wine cellar is pretty cool! The house was built in 1860. It is located on two acres in Covington, Louisiana. The home overlooks Bogue Falaya River and it is situated in the Garden District. There is a beautiful pool, tennis court, pool cabana, beautiful landscaping and an 1860 Canadian dairy barn. Five bedrooms, six bathrooms and 5,051 square feet. $4,950,000 From the Zillow listing: This extraordinary historic esta

item.title: Love the exterior style! Circa 1880 in Vermont. $225,000
item.description: I love the exterior style of this house! The setting seems a bit awkward though. The house was built in 1880. It is located in Chester, Vermont. The house features a nice front porch, large patio with fire pit, wood floors, baseboards and a brick fireplace. The interior could use some character. Just 15 miles from Okemo Mountain.
